POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

3. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

6. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

7. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

9. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

13. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

16. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
